subject_required_conditions: Exactly one CH passport / DE destination / approved method subject selected.
cycle12_job_id_matches and cycle12_enqueue_operation_matches are both true.
state is leased; open_attempt is a nonempty execution-attempt:v3: identifier; lease_expires_at parses and is before observed_at.
Exactly one starts entry has is_current_open_attempt=true, job_matches_cycle12=true, lease_matches_derived_identity=true and leased_job_equals_current=true.
For that current open attempt results=0 and dispositions=0.
All IDs, method and current-job/subject digests have the documented forms; counters remain observational values, never reset.
archive_required_conditions: Exactly one head and its verification qualification resolve.
all_originals_present_and_exact is true; all declared original IDs occur once.
Each actual_body_sha256 equals raw_digest; lengths and digests have valid types.
Prior Owner count and ordered_row_digest_sha256 are retained only as immutable history bindings; they are not a new authorization.
other_required_conditions: Every required=true function has present=true and the stated metadata object; optional absent functions/relations are explicitly present=false with metadata=null.
No ACL, owner, native-definition or configuration value becomes write authority merely because it was observed.
BG1 generation meets the installed bound; incident_generation=resumed_generation and observed_at is earlier than valid_until.
Opaque IDs are operational identifiers; no original body, lease_token, token_hash, signing key, auth-session or actor row may appear.
stop_if: SQL error, unclear answer, extra result row, missing result, timeout or truncated output.
Any explicit guard failure, false required correlation/archive/bounds flag or missing mandatory function metadata.
Changed v4/catalog/scheduler/terminal state or absent natural BG1 proof.
after_read: Only evaluate and preserve the result. Do not run a second read, repair SQL, Owner command, source call, rehearsal or install. Native CAS authority, historical 503 root cause and Production write readiness remain unproven until separately demonstrated.

explicit_small_stop_results.meaning: Stop immediately. No payload/Intake sentinel or other data may accompany a STOP object. No retry, additional read or write.
